content.value:
werecog — One Night Ultimate Werewolf (5 players).

- Deck (8 cards): 2 Werewolf, 1 Seer, 1 Robber, 1 Troublemaker, 1 Insomniac, 2 Villager.
  Five are dealt to players, three go face-down to the center, so 0/1/2 werewolves may be in play.
- NIGHT (roles wake in order): werewolves see each other (a lone wolf may peek one center card);
  the Seer views one player OR two center cards; the Robber may swap its card with another player's
  and see the new one (joining that team); the Troublemaker may swap two other players' cards blind;
  the Insomniac sees its final card.
- Your TEAM at dawn is the card you HOLD (swaps can change it); your DEALT role only sets your night action.
- DAY: players discuss, then everyone votes at once (no self-votes). A player dies only with >=2 votes;
  ties at the maximum all die.
- WIN: village wins if a werewolf is killed; the werewolf team wins if a werewolf is in play and none is
  killed; if no werewolf is in play, the village wins only if nobody dies.

game.name: werecog

global.value:
Read-only spectator feed: the @cogweb/core ServerMessage stream the live console and
replay viewer render (snapshot / event / status / lobby / reset frames). The night
resolves role-by-role, the day is a round-robin discussion, then a single simultaneous
vote reveals the dawn. The saved replay is { protocol:"cogweb.replay.v1", frames:
ServerMessage[] }. Spectators send nothing.

game.description: A five-player hidden-role social-deduction benchmark (One Night Ultimate Werewolf): agents reason about secret roles and night card-swaps, bluff or coordinate through a discussion, and vote to find the werewolves.

seed.description: Deterministic episode seed (the deal is a pure function of it).

tokens.description: Per-seat auth tokens injected by the runner; length is the seat count.

pace_ms.description: Minimum ms between automated decisions, for live viewing.

act_timeout_seconds.description: Per-decision budget before the scripted fallback takes the turn.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for all players to connect before starting anyway.

scores.description: 1 for each seat on the winning team, else 0, in seat order.

winning_team.description: The team that won, or 'none' when an innocent is lynched with no werewolf in play.

player.name: werecog Scripted Baseline
player.description: Deterministic no-LLM baseline (skips the night, votes the next seat). Certifies the contract offline.

player.name: werecog LLM Baseline
player.description: A Bedrock-driven policy that plays the seat through the game's autopilot (system prompt + per-turn tool).
